name: krylo
description: Autonomous, evidence-driven software-development workflow. One explicit command turns a task into a controlled run: acceptance criteria, minimal agent team, deterministic verification, independent review, bounded Orbit loop, and an evidence-backed final report.

language.title: Report language
language.description: Final-report language: auto, en, or he.

autonomy_level.title: Autonomy level
autonomy_level.description: How much KRYLO decides alone: safe, standard, or high.

max_orbit_cycles.title: Maximum Orbit cycles
max_orbit_cycles.description: A cap, not a target. Each run still starts from its risk-based Orbit budget (low=3, medium=5, high=7); this setting can only lower that budget further for every run, never raise it, and never above the platform-safe maximum of 10.

status_detail.title: Status detail
status_detail.description: Status-line verbosity: minimal, normal, or detailed.

local_telemetry.title: Local telemetry
local_telemetry.description: Persist local-only run metadata (never sent anywhere). Disable to keep no run history.

telemetry_retention_days.title: Telemetry retention (days)
telemetry_retention_days.description: How long local run metadata is kept before cleanup.

security_profile.title: Security profile
security_profile.description: Active data-egress profile: local-only, private-approved, public-repository, or production-read-only.
